sloka: एवं तत्र मया दृष्टः कुम्भकर्णौ निशाचरः ।रावणस्य सुताः सर्वे तृष्टास्तैलसमुक्षिताः ।। ५.२७.२९।।।।
transliteration: evaṁ tatra mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kumbhakarṇau niśācaraḥ ।rāvaṇasya sutāḥ sarve tṛṣṭāstailasamukṣitāḥ ।। 5.27.29।।।।

translations.english: "There I saw the nightranger, Kumbhakarna and also Ravana's sons, their bodies smeared with oil.
